name: Abijah (Jeroboam's son)
title: Jeroboam I's son who died young
summary: Abijah was the son of Jeroboam I. When the boy fell ill, Jeroboam sent his wife in disguise to the prophet Ahijah, who predicted that the child would die—the only one from Jeroboam's house to receive a honorable burial, because there was something good in him.

keyEvents.title: The prophecy of his death
keyEvents.description: The prophet Ahijah predicted that Jeroboam's sick son Abijah would die as soon as his mother returned home, and so it happened.
